Sequence · 12 working days
  • Day 1 — approve scope, send landlord letter, order bedding, bath linen, chairs, dining chairs. Buy the paint sample pot
  • Day 2 — brush the navy on the real wall, check it at 9am, 3pm and 9pm. Then order paint. Send print files
  • Day 3–4 — shop in person: UMA, Baya, Hoa Sen Home, Mollis, then the flower market. Approve one 40×30 print proof
  • Day 5–6 — paint, two coats, then leave those rooms alone
  • Day 7 — deliveries checked, all bedding and towels washed once before use
  • Day 8 — measure the desk edge first, then build the workstations. Window to the side, not behind the monitor
  • Day 9 — hang eight prints and the mirror, centres at 150cm. Frost the laundry glass
  • Day 10 — beds made with the fold, bathrooms set, cushions, lamps, plants, niche dressed, balcony built, old rugs out
  • Day 11 — photograph mid-morning and at golden hour, same nine angles as this document
  • Day 12 — walk it as a guest, then write the reset sheet: one laminated photo per room inside a cupboard door
